Includes the shift-work amendment: 'rested' keys on hours into YOUR waking day (15:00-23:00 shift means home-at-midnight is your 17:00), never wall clock. Marathon sessions and dirty runs (god/slow-mo/runtime edits) stay PROVISIONAL under every option.
